items.text: Fixed bundled skins appearing blank after checkout and corrected fullscreen skin viewer paging on bundles.
Fixed bundles of tradable skins being incorrectly marked as non‑tradable.
Resolved crate generators not being recognized as bundles.

Fixed several parenting bugs that caused players to be incorrectly attached to cargo ships, excavator arms, or dragged off ladders when moving between boats or climbing ladders. The system now prefers the current parent’s trigger, respects exclusion zones, and prevents unwanted ladder detachment.
Strafing now cancels sprint and a crouch‑strafe bug has been fixed, making sprinting and crouching behave as expected.
Recoil application duration reduced by 75% on most weapons, resulting in tighter control while firing.
Updated Scrap King physics material to metal, affecting weapon interactions.
Added gingerbread physics material to low and half walls for gingerbread building skins.
Tech tree shuffled and reorganized: new editor added, trees (IO, tier 1‑3) rearranged, new layouts for Hardcore and Primitive modes, and column alignment improvements.
Tech tree opens up to fully unlocked Tier 2 in ~150 ms, a ten‑fold speedup with unlock results unchanged.
Sandbox objects can now be selected with a single click, fixing the previous two‑click requirement.
Sprint mechanics updated to the modern system, altering acceleration and stamina handling for smoother, more responsive sprinting.

2026-11-25.summary:
### Workshop & Economy
- Fixed bundled skins appearing blank after checkout and corrected fullscreen skin viewer paging on bundles.
- Fixed bundles of tradable skins being incorrectly marked as non‑tradable.
- Resolved crate generators not being recognized as bundles.

### Movement & Interaction
- Fixed several parenting bugs that caused players to be incorrectly attached to cargo ships, excavator arms, or dragged off ladders when moving between boats or climbing ladders. The system now prefers the current parent’s trigger, respects exclusion zones, and prevents unwanted ladder detachment.
- Strafing now cancels sprint and a crouch‑strafe bug has been fixed, making sprinting and crouching behave as expected.

### Combat Tweaks
- Recoil application duration reduced by 75% on most weapons, resulting in tighter control while firing.
- Updated Scrap King physics material to metal, affecting weapon interactions.
- Added gingerbread physics material to low and half walls for gingerbread building skins.

### Tech Tree & Progression
- Tech tree shuffled and reorganized: new editor added, trees (IO, tier 1‑3) rearranged, new layouts for Hardcore and Primitive modes, and column alignment improvements.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Tech tree opens up to fully unlocked Tier 2 in ~150 ms, a ten‑fold speedup with unlock results unchanged.
- Sandbox objects can now be selected with a single click, fixing the previous two‑click requirement.
- Sprint mechanics updated to the modern system, altering acceleration and stamina handling for smoother, more responsive sprinting.
